children: C & F Financial published its third-quarter 2026 investor presentation, reporting higher quarterly net income and a 4.53% net interest margin.
The presentation was published November 5 and may be used by the company and management in fourth-quarter investor meetings.
Third-quarter net income was $8.257 million, up from $7.113 million a year earlier; earnings per share rose to $2.55 from $2.18.
Net interest margin increased to 4.53% from 4.24% in the third quarter of 2025.
Total assets were $2.81 billion and deposits were $2.36 billion as of September 30, 2026.
The presentation showed nine-month net income of $23.677 million and earnings per share of $7.26.
